sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Unknown key (Unknown) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key found on the dead messenger's body. The lock location is unknown.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest The Extortionist

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Can be found on a dead Scav which is located in a bush behind garages. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Opens a cabin at the crane yard on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: Nothing unless the quest The Extortionist is active.
